column2: [intro]
I am addicted to dark rooms, to flickering lights
To the sound of the projector, my heart beats, it stirs
Crazy comedies, fantastic sagas
Cinema is my drug, it's fantastic
I am a cinephile, I watch the old stacks
The classics in black and white, they make me so happy
Funny and touching movies, I've seen thousands
It's my passion, my reason to shine
I am always in front of the screen, eyes wide open
Emotions are jostling, I am transported
Great actors, explosive dialogues
I laugh, I cry, I intensely live each fictional scene
I am a cinephile, I watch the old stacks
The classics in black and white, they make me so happy
Funny and touching movies, I've seen thousands
It's my passion, my reason to shine
